run_singlepoint_calculations: run singlepoint energy and force calculations on a batch of atomic structures using an ASE calculator
calculate_properties_for_atoms: calculate specified properties like energy and forces for atoms in an AtomsSequence dataset
write_singlepoint_results: write singlepoint calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the results directory
chunk_singlepoint_jobs: split singlepoint calculations across multiple jobs for parallel processing of atomic structures
save_atoms_with_results: save JSON serialized ASE Atoms objects alongside calculated properties in the results output
